architecture.summary: T2: declarations changed in 3 public modules; 2 registry views edited

reasons.fact: S2.5-01c connects Members to the existing removal coordinator through one checked browser POST. A domain-owned removable hint controls native confirmation visibility; current authority, target, revision, last-Admin, durable admission, and bounded provider work remain in the coordinator. Fixed responses separate completion from later reads and use existing identity-only selection, signup recovery, and sign-in guidance. Trusted tenant capture adds removal action, membership ID, and outcomes to the existing AuditLog and OTLP contract; capture failure cannot alter results, settle holds, or replay deletion. The public overview, form parser, and AuditLog declarations change, and two registry views describe the caller and capture. No component, dependency pair, container, provider, datastore, configuration, or deployment topology is added. A dedicated Chromium gate checks the native keyboard flow at a narrow viewport. No MFA, role changes, live migration, legal publication, or release is included.
